{{Top}}
'''Prince-Admiral''' was the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] assumed by [[Delak Krennel]] as ruler of the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] region after Krennel set himself up as an independent [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].

The title itself had little real meaning and was only known to have been used by Krennel after his abandonment of the failing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The title presumably fell out of favor following his [[Death/Legends|death]] during the second [[Battle of Ciutric|attack on Ciutric IV]].

The title was also used in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] near the end of the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]]. [[Jonash e Solo]] was the Prince-Admiral of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|Seventeenth Conflict]], when he personally ended the conflict by forcing a [[Alsakan Conflicts peace treaty|peace treaty]] at [[Sword/Legends|swordpoint]] on the floor of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] chamber.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
